summary: Code review PASS with two Fix-Forward JSDoc updates applied directly.

importStandaloneProject() is correctly scoped as a pure storage orchestrator — it accepts pre-computed fields and delegates all business logic (outcome summary extraction, pipeline summary lines) to the caller, satisfying the separation of concerns contract.

The withLock + writeWorkPackage + writeRootIndex sequence is idiomatic and consistent with initializeProject(); all writes go through atomicWriteJson(); .meta.json is auto-synced via writeRootIndex() without a redundant writeProjectMeta call.
The ImportStandaloneDetail interface is well-documented and placed immediately before SlugConflictError — a natural export boundary.

Test suite (9 cases in describe('importStandaloneProject')) provides excellent coverage: root index shape, WP detail shape, pipeline summary passthrough, .meta.json sync, outcome_summary (non-null and null), document archival, missing synthesis graceful skip, and computeHealedStatus invariant.

Fix-Forward 2: Updated writeWorkPackage @internal JSDoc: changed 'NO legitimate external callers' to 'no legitimate external callers' and documented importStandaloneProject as the sole approved internal exception, clarifying that the restriction targets tool code outside LedgerStore, not internal LedgerStore methods that bootstrap projects from scratch.

comments.note: ledger-store.ts writeRootIndex @internal allowlist: added importStandaloneProject() as an explicitly approved direct caller. Listing it in the allowlist prevents future contributors from incorrectly treating it as a violation and refactoring it toward a sync method (which would be wrong for a from-scratch bootstrap).
